differential: Epilepsy

Brain tumor
A brain tumor can cause new-onset seizures in children due to increased intracranial pressure or direct irritation of brain tissue.
Meningitis
Infections such as meningitis can lead to seizures in children due to inflammation of the brain and surrounding tissues.
Metabolic disorder
Metabolic disorders, such as hypoglycemia or electrolyte imbalances, can precipitate seizures in children.
